readme.en:
AECC Battery brings local control of AECC-platform plug-in home batteries to Homey. It connects directly to the battery over your home network, without a cloud round-trip, and shows live charge state, power flow and energy totals in Homey, alongside the ability to set a charge or discharge target and hand control back to the battery's own logic at any time. It is built for owners of Sunpura, Lunergy, Voltdeer, AEG Solarcube, AFERIY, AccuMate, JET, Oscal and other batteries that share this platform, who want their battery to show up alongside the rest of their home in Homey Energy and flows.

The battery accepts only one connection at a time, so this app cannot run alongside the vendor app's local mode or a Home Assistant integration talking to the same battery at the same time. The protocol and its quirks were worked out for the sibling Home Assistant integration and are documented for anyone who wants to read further or contribute.
readme.nl:
AECC Batterij brengt lokale besturing van stekkerbatterijen op het AECC-platform naar Homey. De app maakt rechtstreeks verbinding met je batterij via je eigen netwerk, zonder omweg via de cloud, en laat de laadtoestand, het actuele vermogen en de energietotalen in Homey zien. Je stelt zelf een laad- of ontlaadvermogen in, en je geeft de besturing op elk moment weer terug aan de batterij zelf. Gemaakt voor iedereen met een Sunpura, Lunergy, Voltdeer, AEG Solarcube, AFERIY, AccuMate, JET, Oscal of een andere batterij op hetzelfde platform, die de batterij wil laten meedraaien in Homey Energie en in flows.

De batterij accepteert maar één verbinding tegelijk. Deze app kan dus niet tegelijk met de lokale modus van de app van de fabrikant of met een Home Assistant-integratie op dezelfde batterij draaien. Het protocol en alle eigenaardigheden ervan zijn uitgeplozen voor de Home Assistant-integratie van hetzelfde project en staan gedocumenteerd voor wie verder wil lezen of wil meebouwen.

desc.en: Resets the charged and discharged energy meters to zero. This breaks the continuity of this device's history in Homey Energy.
desc.nl: Zet de meters voor geladen en ontladen energie terug naar nul. Dit onderbreekt de continuïteit van de geschiedenis van dit apparaat in Homey Energie.

hint.en: Fires once all retries are exhausted without an acknowledgement from the battery.
hint.nl: Wordt geactiveerd nadat alle nieuwe pogingen zijn uitgeput zonder bevestiging van de batterij.

hint.en: Fires when the battery's actual setpoint no longer matched what was last written and this app restored it.
hint.nl: Wordt geactiveerd wanneer het werkelijke setpoint van de batterij niet meer overeenkwam met wat laatst is geschreven en deze app het heeft hersteld.

hint.en: Fires once when polling stops producing fresh data, not repeatedly while the battery stays unreachable.
hint.nl: Wordt eenmalig geactiveerd wanneer het pollen geen verse data meer oplevert, niet herhaaldelijk zolang de batterij onbereikbaar blijft.

hint.nl: Vers betekent dat er binnen het opgegeven aantal seconden een succesvolle meting is binnengekomen. Gebruik dit om andere acties te beschermen tegen verouderde data.

title.nl: Laad op met een ingesteld vermogen

hint.en: Sets the mode to Homey control and charges at this power. Also callable from HomeyScript.
hint.nl: Zet de modus op Homey-besturing en laadt op met dit vermogen. Ook aanroepbaar vanuit HomeyScript.

hint.en: Sets the mode to Homey control and discharges at this power. Also callable from HomeyScript.
hint.nl: Zet de modus op Homey-besturing en ontlaadt met dit vermogen. Ook aanroepbaar vanuit HomeyScript.

hint.en: Holds an active 0W setpoint with energy management still enabled, unlike switching to self-consumption mode which hands control back to the battery.
hint.nl: Houdt een actief setpoint van 0W aan met energiebeheer nog steeds ingeschakeld, in tegenstelling tot overschakelen naar zelfconsumptiemodus waarbij de besturing wordt teruggegeven aan de batterij.

titleFormatted.en: Set discharge limit to [[min_soc]] and charge limit to [[max_soc]]
titleFormatted.nl: Stel ontlaadlimiet in op [[min_soc]] en oplaadlimiet op [[max_soc]]

hint.en: Rewrites the current target power to the battery without changing its value. Useful as a recovery step after a failed control command.
hint.nl: Schrijft het huidige doelvermogen opnieuw naar de batterij zonder de waarde te wijzigen. Handig als herstelstap na een mislukt besturingscommando.

readme.en:
Control and monitor your Leapmotor directly from Homey. No intermediary server, the app talks to Leapmotor's cloud the same way the official mobile app does. Your car becomes a first-class citizen in your flows: it reports what it is doing, and it does what you ask. Highlights:  SOC with 0.1% precision, custom range, unlimited geofencing (latitude/longitude), plug type detection (CCS / Type 2), battery temperature, battery heating, etc.

IDEAS TO GET YOU STARTED
- Garage door opens: unlock the car (Presuming your Bluetooth key doesn't work either)
- CCS cable detected: send a notification at every 10% SOC step while fast charging
- Bathroom motion after 6:00AM on a workday + below 4C° outside: start the defrost
- Build your own geofencing from the latitude/longitude
- Advanced charging plans around your energy tariff

SETUP: USE A SECOND ACCOUNT
Do not log into homey with your main Leapmotor account. Leapmotor can block unofficial access without warning, and you do not want to lose the app that opens your car. Steps:
1. Create a NEW Leapmotor account in the Leapmotor mobile app. Use a second phone or tablet if you have one - the app can be removed afterwards. No spare device? Log out of your own Leapmotor app, create the new account there, then log back in with your main account.
2. In the Leapmotor app with your MAIN account: Personal Center > My vehicle > tap your vehicle > Shared member > Add shared member, and give it the permissions you want Homey to have.
3. Accept the shared vehicle on the second account.
4. Add the vehicle in Homey using the second account.

BEFORE YOU START - PLEASE READ
- Unofficial and unsupported. It uses a non-official API that can change, break or behave unpredictably at any time. Verify in a safe environment what it does before you rely on it. 
- Rate limits are real. Too much polling or too many commands can get an account temporarily blocked. Keep it reasonable.
- You are in charge. You accept responsibility for anything that follows vehicle damage, accidents, account locks or data issues.
- The PIN is optional. Leave it blank and the app is read-only, all the sensor data, none of the remote commands. Fill it in and the commands unlock.

KNOWN LIMITS AND HONEST SMALL PRINT
- Tested on a B10. Other models (B05, C10, T03, C16) should work but may have per-vehicle quirks
- The Leapmotor cryptography is heavy for older Homeys. On an early-2016 Homey it works, but it can hiccup if you ask it to do several things at once. Give commands a moment to breathe.
- Not everything works on every vehicle: seat adjustment, sentry, restarting the Bluetooth key are the usual suspects.
- Some API functions are deliberately not implemented: autopark, summon & Co are not available on export models. If you know the cmdId you can still fire them with the raw command card.

readme.en:
Adds support for NovaDigital Zigbee wall switches (1 to 6 gang) and smart plugs to Homey, with a focus on reliable behavior and correct reporting.

Wall switches restore both their on/off state and configuration after a power outage. The backlight can be set to remain off even when power is restored. Multi-gang models correctly report the status of each individual outlet. Devices that stop responding are shown as unavailable in Homey — even before they fully leave the Zigbee network.

Smart plugs report power, current, voltage and accumulated energy, and use availability detection to avoid unnecessary polling after being unplugged.

All mains-powered devices (switches, plugs) fire a "Reconnected after power cut" flow trigger the moment they rejoin the Zigbee network. This works even for short outages that wouldn't normally trip the unavailability alarm. Use it to automate scenes like "breaker came back → turn on the lights". Detection is based on low-level firmware signals that fire only on power restore — not on periodic traffic — ensuring no false triggers. A 120-second startup delay and a 30-second cooldown provide additional protection against triggers on app restart.

A Settings page (App → Settings) shows live Zigbee traffic and rejoin statistics for every paired device, useful for spotting flaky mesh coverage or a plug that keeps power-cycling.

Supported devices:
- NovaDigital wall switches — 1, 2, 2 Touch, 3, 4, 4 ZCL and 6 gang
- NovaDigital smart plugs (with power/energy metering)

description.en: Wall switches (1-6 gang) and smart plugs for NovaDigital Zigbee devices.

readme.en:
Control your Bubendorff shutters (iDiamant by Netatmo / Legrand "Home + Control") directly from Homey: open, close, set a precise position, or stop, and see their current position update automatically.

Requirements
------------
This app requires Homey Pro (local). It is not compatible with Homey Cloud.

You also need your own Netatmo developer app, since Netatmo does not allow sharing a single Client ID/Secret across installations:

1. Go to https://dev.netatmo.com/apps and create a new app.
2. Set its redirect URI to: https://callback.athom.com/oauth2/callback
3. Open this app's Settings page (More > Apps > iDiamant by Netatmo > Settings), enter your Client ID and Client Secret, then click "Connect" and sign in with your Netatmo account.
4. Add your shutters: Devices > Add device > iDiamant by Netatmo.

Supported devices
-----------------
Bubendorff roller shutters, tilting shutters (BSO) and swing shutters connected through a Bubendorff gateway on a Netatmo Home + Control / iDiamant account. Note: the Netatmo API does not currently expose a separate tilt control for BSO units, only an open/closed position.

Notes
-----
The app polls the Netatmo API to keep positions in sync: once a minute by default, or every 5 minutes if you set up an optional Netatmo webhook (see the Settings page) for near-instant updates instead.
readme.fr:
Pilotez vos volets Bubendorff (iDiamant by Netatmo / Legrand "Home + Control") directement depuis Homey : ouverture, fermeture, position précise ou arrêt, avec mise à jour automatique de la position actuelle.

Prérequis
---------
Cette app nécessite un Homey Pro (local). Elle n'est pas compatible avec Homey Cloud.

Vous devez également créer votre propre app développeur Netatmo, Netatmo n'autorisant pas le partage d'un même Client ID/Secret entre plusieurs installations :

1. Rendez-vous sur https://dev.netatmo.com/apps et créez une nouvelle app.
2. Renseignez cette URI de redirection : https://callback.athom.com/oauth2/callback
3. Ouvrez la page Réglages de cette app (Plus > Apps > iDiamant by Netatmo > Réglages), saisissez votre Client ID et Client Secret, puis cliquez sur "Se connecter" pour vous authentifier avec votre compte Netatmo.
4. Ajoutez vos volets : Appareils > Ajouter un appareil > iDiamant by Netatmo.

Appareils pris en charge
-------------------------
Volets roulants, BSO (brise-soleil orientables) et volets battants Bubendorff connectés via une passerelle Bubendorff sur un compte Netatmo Home + Control / iDiamant. À noter : l'API Netatmo n'expose pas de commande d'inclinaison distincte pour les BSO, uniquement une position ouvert/fermé.

Remarques
---------
L'app interroge l'API Netatmo pour garder les positions synchronisées : une fois par minute par défaut, ou toutes les 5 minutes si vous configurez un webhook Netatmo optionnel (voir la page Réglages) pour des mises à jour quasi instantanées.
